# Psychometric Digital Twin: appendix {.page-title}

[Cohort · models · tiers · metrics]{.kicker}

Supporting definitions for the [Psychometric Digital Twin case study](../psychometric-digital-twin.qmd). No respondent-level records appear here.

## Cohort

| Step | Count |
| --- | ---: |
| Matched Prolific and Qualtrics records | 252 |
| Complete on both PRCA-24 subscales | 241 |
| LLM runs | Single passes, not cross-validated |
| Classical models | 5-fold cross-validated |

## Model roster

| Family | Members |
| --- | --- |
| Classical | Ridge, Elastic Net, k-NN, random forest, histogram gradient boosting, XGBoost, small neural net |
| LLM | Llama 3.1 8B Instruct, Llama 3.2 3B Instruct, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B, Llama 3.3 70B Instruct (AWQ) |

Llama 3.2 3B base could not follow the output format and is excluded from the scores.

## Prompt tiers

| Tier | Adds |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Demographics |
| 2 | Employment |
| 3 | Survey location |
| 4 | Transit and ride-share habits |
| 5 | Two open-text answers (LLMs only) |

Classical models see the tabular tiers; the LLM prompts add the open text.

## Metrics

| Metric | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Error in points | Mean absolute error on the 6–30 subscale |
| Exact match | Predicted band equals the reported band |
| Band accuracy | Low, moderate or high agreement |
| Band F1 | Classification quality across low, moderate and high bands |
| AUC | Ranking quality for low versus high apprehension |
| Group error | Error computed within demographic groups |

The constant-guess baseline is 4.93 points by my calculation from the cohort table. The best classical model (Ridge at the transit tier) reaches 4.49; the best pooled LLM run reaches 5.02, so it does not clear the constant.

## Scope

The LLM runs are single passes and the test split is small. Group comparisons are descriptive, not causal. The report carries the full tables and the commands.
